_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_mechanics#10 — on the WALL element EAS and STRESS_STRAIN are not cosmetic, and they fail in opposite ways. Six arms of one 1x1 WALL QUAD4 unit square (YOUNG 1000, NUE 0.3, THICK 1.0, GP 2 2, left edge clamped, right edge line Neumann VAL 1 in y, dispy read at the loaded corner node 2), every comparison at the SAME node and the SAME kinematics, run 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C. The reference arms (KINEM nonlinear + EAS none + plane_strain; KINEM linear + EAS none + plane_strain) exit 0 with their RESULT DESCRIPTION pinned at 1e-12. The contrast arms reuse that same pinned test and it fires: EAS none -> full moves the tip deflection by EAS_FULL_SHIFT_PERCENT=23.1 and plane_strain -> plane_stress by PLANE_STRESS_SHIFT_PERCENT=6.7, both read out of 4C's own 'is WRONG --> actresult=' line rather than asserted from prose. Neither run says anything about the keyword responsible — NL_EAS_FULL_WARNS_ABOUT_EAS=0, LIN_STRESS_WARNS_ABOUT_STRESS_STRAIN=0 — and the only error block in either log is the result test itself (*_ONLY_ERROR_IS_THE_RESULT_TEST=yes), which is exactly why a real deck without a result test says nothing at all. The loud branch is the other one: 'EAS full' with KINEM linear exits 1 with 'ERROR: No EAS for geometrically linear WALL element' from w1/4C_w1_input.cpp line 143, for both STRESS_STRAIN settings. So the EAS trap stops the run and the STRESS_STRAIN trap lets it lie.
expect_in_output: ERROR: No EAS for geometrically linear WALL element

_mutation.note: remove the contrast from the EAS arm: switch EAS off so it becomes a copy of the reference. The 23.1% shift disappears (the result test passes and nothing prints a percentage), so the fixture must go red.
remove the contrast from the STRESS_STRAIN arm the same way. The 6.7% shift disappears, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the loud arm: give EAS the nonlinear kinematics it requires. The w1_input throw disappears and EXIT_LIN_EAS_FULL_STRAIN becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
